summary: M2 Project-centric workspace validated end-to-end. Backend: 11 in-process pytest cases in test_m2_projects.py + 15 new HTTP-through-ingress cases in test_m2_http.py all pass (26/26, 100%). Verified: empty list, create youtube/instagram_reel/instagram_post/instagram_carousel with correct platform mapping, reject content_type='tiktok' (400), GET nonexistent -> 404, PATCH title bumps updated_at, PATCH status='researching' OK / 'bogus' -> 400, discard hides from list, brief PUT partial-update preserves unset keys and persists across refetch, creative-object CRUD (invalid type='poem' -> 400), activity events include project_created/brief_updated/project_status_changed/creative_object_created, ownership isolation via directly-seeded foreign-creator project returns 404 on all 5 endpoints (GET/PATCH project, PUT brief, GET creative-objects, GET activity). Frontend: /app renders projects-dashboard + projects-empty; new-project-btn opens dialog; created project navigates to /app/projects/:id; brief-topic autosave shows 'All changes saved' within ~1s; brief content persists after reload; project-status-select changes to 'Ready' and persists across reload; tab-content renders content-empty then new-object-btn creates a NOTES card with data-testid='creative-object-<uuid>' visible; Research/Direction/Ship tabs render placeholder-research/direction/ship as expected (non-functional); back-to-projects returns to dashboard with project-card-<id> and project-status-<id> chip='Ready'; discard flow (project-discard-btn -> project-confirm-discard) removes card and empty state reappears.

design_issues.screen: New project dialog + Discard confirm dialog
issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — console warning ‘Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}’. Add a <DialogDescription> for accessibility.

action_items: Add <DialogDescription> to new-project dialog and discard-confirm dialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: M2 route handlers and repositories look clean; ownership check is enforced by _owner_key filter — every read/write path returns 404 on foreign-creator rows without leaking existence. Good.
Autosave uses debounce visible via brief-save-state text ‘All changes saved’ within ~1s; persists to /projects/{id}/brief PUT with partial-key semantics. Confirmed by refetch.
Consider a DELETE /projects/{id} soft-delete alias for symmetry — currently discard = PATCH status='discarded', which is fine but couple it with GET default-filter, already correct.
seed_data_creation: Wiped projects/creative_objects/activity_events before frontend E2E. Ownership isolation test seeds one project with creator_id='other-creator' and deletes it in the finally block. Regression Idea Lab / Assistant not re-run (out of scope for M2).
